agents.name: Communications surveillance
agents.mission: Read every outbound draft and every captured message in both directions, decide the supervisory regime, and hold anything that cannot go out as written.
agents.mirrors: The electronic communications review team: correspondence sampling, the retail communication line, privacy on approved channels, generated text under supervision.

agents.name: Marketing review
agents.mirrors: The marketing review desk: performance, projections and testimonials in advisory-capacity material, before it reaches a client.
agents.mission: Read every client-facing draft and captured outbound message for performance, projection or testimonial content, and hold it until it is compliant as written.

agents.name: Complaints
agents.mirrors: The complaints desk: identify a grievance in what the client wrote, log it, and start the clock the reporting rule runs on.
agents.mission: Read every inbound message for grievance language that no one logged, and prepare the log entry and the callback.

agents.name: Record completeness
agents.mission: Compare what the advisor says they use against what is actually captured, and name the exposure on every gap.
agents.mirrors: The books and records function: is every channel the advisor uses captured, retained and producible on request.

agents.name: Recommendation evidence
agents.mission: Before a recommendation is released, check the care-obligation record is complete: basis, alternatives, costs, why this client.
agents.mirrors: The care-obligation reviewer: basis, reasonably available alternatives, costs, and why this client, before a recommendation is released.

agents.name: Sales practice
agents.mirrors: The branch supervisor's suitability review: concentration against the household's own ceiling, and the trend toward it.
agents.mission: Read every account against its own stated profile, at a point and over ninety days, and prepare the conversation before the ceiling is crossed.

agents.name: Vulnerable client protection
agents.mission: Watch every specified adult's account for the indicators the rule names, and prepare the hold and the callback a person makes.
agents.mirrors: The senior investor desk: exploitation indicators on specified adults, trusted contacts, holds on disbursements.

agents.name: Conduct
agents.mission: Outside business activities and private securities transactions, read from the captured corpus, where the firm has switched the rule on.
agents.mirrors: The registered representative conduct desk: outside business activities and private securities transactions, from what was actually written.

_note: One agent per review desk, mirroring how a legal, risk and compliance function splits the work. Each carries the human team it mirrors, the authorities it applies, the rules it watches and a cadence. Every field is data; an advisor layer may tighten any of them and loosen none.
